claim_scope: Research-only bounded replay evidence for a Tau command-occurrence replay index expressed as a tau-value table. Seen occurrence ids are key-only facts. Freshness is occurrence_probe & seen', which preserves a never-seen key and annihilates a reused key. Command contribution is command_row & fresh, so a reused occurrence id is suppressed even when the attacker changes other command fields. The temporal run updates seen and command tables only through this lattice-difference gate on the exact locked Tau source.
failure_modes: a never-seen occurrence key is annihilated instead of admitted
an already-seen occurrence key survives the freshness difference
reusing an occurrence id with a changed amount or other payload survives the gate
a duplicate occurrence changes the seen table
a fresh occurrence fails to become represented by the seen table
the computed fresh contribution overlaps the prior seen table
the replay table is executed against a mutable Tau branch instead of the exact source lock

aaa.reason: The replay arranges unseen, seen, and seen-with-changed-payload occurrence cases, acts by lattice difference and command-row meet inside Tau, and asserts the frozen theorem sequence plus structured temporal execution on the exact locked source.

reject_is_noop.reason: A reused occurrence id makes fresh = 0. Both seen | 0 and commands | (command_row & 0) preserve their previous table values, so replay rejection is an exact logical no-op.

boundary_dimensions.name: payload_replay
points: a fresh command row survives the occurrence gate
a command that reuses key 1 with a different amount is annihilated

boundary_dimensions.name: seen_update
points: duplicate-key update is an exact no-op
fresh key becomes represented after update
fresh contribution is disjoint from prior seen

nonclaims: This evidence grants no production, settlement, publication, verifier, migration, release, or value-moving authority.
Occurrence ids and command fields are bounded abstract tags; this does not model production canonical occurrence hashes or u128/u256 values.
This is a logical replay index, not a physical persistence, crash-consistency, concurrency, distributed-consensus, or storage-durability proof.

The contract assumes the host supplies an occurrence_probe that exactly fixes the same occurrence_id represented inside command_row; a production binding proof between canonical command encoding and the probe remains separate.
This evidence does not prove authorization, balance sufficiency, fees, signatures, asset policy, settlement validity, or receipt hashing.
This evidence does not close O-008 or any whole-value-movement gate and does not make P22 current.
